minutes.headline: Town Meeting passed over both TC Passios building articles after cost estimates jumped; routine budget articles passed.
minutes.summary: The special town meeting handled a consent calendar, FY2022 budget adjustments, a prior-year bill, a firefighter contract transfer and a sewer enterprise amendment, all by unanimous voice. Most of the evening went to the TC Passios renovation and new-build articles, where updated estimates rose sharply and the Select Board moved to pass both over. The meeting also amended and passed a demolition delay bylaw change, passed a zoning name change, passed over two aquifer protection articles, and approved a lot area table correction.

what_happened.line: Town Meeting voted to pass over both TC Passios building articles, the renovation and the new-build design funds, after updated cost estimates rose sharply.
Select Board members and others indicated they plan to bring revised building proposals back at the May annual town meeting.
The routine budget articles all passed unanimously: FY2022 adjustments and transfers, prior-year bills, a firefighter contract transfer and a sewer enterprise amendment.
The demolition delay bylaw change (Article 14) passed as amended; the Select Board's recommendation of the amended text carried 3-1.
A zoning name change passed unanimously, two aquifer protection articles were passed over, and a lot area table change passed by more than two-thirds.

why_it_matters: The TC Passios building project, whose debt service the finance director said exceeds the town's debt policy limit in several years, is not funded or designed yet, so a revised proposal and a borrowing vote are likely to come back to residents.
Debt exclusions sit outside the 2.5 percent levy limit, so any building loan approved later would add to tax bills on top of normal growth.
The demolition delay bylaw change affects what owners of older structures must do before tearing them down.
watch_next: The May annual town meeting, where revised building proposals are expected to return.
